anyOf.description: content path of a material asset (no extension)

materials.description: material slots: wall, glass, frame, roof (modules and roofs can use more slots)

seed.description: random seed for the A|B choices in the patterns: another number is another building of the same kind

footprint.description: outline: points [[x, z], …], { rect: [width, depth], center } or { circle: radius, segments, center }; unset is the mass below moved in by inset

inset.description: moves every edge of the outline inward (setbacks); unit: m

base.description: height of the bottom of this mass; unset stacks it on the one below (side-by-side towers, sky bridges); unit: m

floorHeight.description: height of one floor; unit: m

facade.description: name of the facade rule; unset is plain wall

roof.description: { kind: 'flat', parapet }, { kind: 'dome', height, rings } or { kind: 'pyramid', height }; material is a slot (default 3); default flat

masses.description: masses stacked bottom up; every edge of the outline is a facade

facades.description: facade rules by name: { floors: [{ where: 'ground' | 'top' (unset: any floor), pattern: 'Pillar [Window Window]* Pillar', ledge: { height, depth } }] }; the first matching rule is used, * repeats to fill the edge, A|B picks one per column by the seed

modules.description: facade modules by name, one floor high: { kind: 'wall' | 'window' (sill, head, margin, depth, frame, mullions, balcony) | 'pillar' (depth) | 'curtain' (frame) | 'panel' (margin, sill, head, depth, material: signs, light strips), width, slots: { wall, glass, frame } (other material slots) }
